description: This Java class 'AlarmAssignmentTriggerProcessor' implements notification trigger processing for alarm assignment events, including filtering and notification info construction.

classes.name: AlarmAssignmentTriggerProcessor
classes.description: Implements processing logic for alarm assignment notification triggers, including filtering and notification info creation.

methods.name: matchesFilter
methods.description: Determines if a given alarm assignment trigger matches the specified trigger configuration based on action, alarm type, severity, and status.

methods.name: constructNotificationInfo

methods.name: getTriggerType
